name: Vespid Dynamics Toxic Environment Navigation Drone TEND-3
product_name: Vespid Dynamics Toxic Environment Navigation Drone TEND-3
description: A ruggedized drone designed to navigate chemically, biologically, or radiologically contaminated environments and map safe passage routes for human operators. The TEND-3 carries a comprehensive CBRN sensor suite and projects its findings as a real-time 3D contamination map, highlighting lethal zones, marginal areas, and safe corridors. The drone can operate in environments that would kill an unprotected human — toxic gas concentrations, high radiation fields, and biological contamination zones — and its sealed construction prevents it from becoming a contamination vector on return. It has become essential equipment for operations in GLMZ's legacy contamination zones.

specifications.decontamination: UV + chemical wash protocol between missions

story_hooks: A TEND-3 mapping a legacy contamination zone discovered a pocket of breathable air deep inside a toxic area — inside the pocket was a functioning habitat where someone has been living in the middle of a wasteland.
A TEND-3 sent into a suspected chemical attack site returned data showing a contaminant that does not match any known industrial or military compound — it is something new, and it is spreading.

physical_description.visual_profile: Compact hexacopter with a distinctly armored aesthetic. The fuselage resembles a hardened insect carapace, with six reinforced carbon-fiber rotors arranged in a tight hex formation. A prominent sensor pod dominates the undercarriage, bristling with intake ports, optical windows, and radiometric detectors. The overall silhouette suggests both technological precision and biological inspiration—predatory, purposeful.
physical_description.dimensions: 38 cm diameter rotor span; 22 cm fuselage length; 18 cm height with sensor pod extended
physical_description.weight_description: 1.5 kg—handheld, easily pocketable in a padded flight case or reinforced carry satchel
physical_description.primary_material: Sealed titanium-alloy frame with impact-resistant polycarbonate sensor shrouding and HDPE decontamination-resistant composite panels
physical_description.finish: Matte industrial gray with rubberized grip points; sensor windows feature anti-reflective sapphire coating; rotor arms show wear-resistant anodized aluminum
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary; high-visibility safety orange accent stripes on rotor arms and sensor pod perimeter; neon green contamination warning chevrons on undercarriage
physical_description.interface_elements: Six indicator LEDs (green/amber/red) clustered on dorsal spine; miniature data-sync port (magnetic contact, decontaminable); dual intake apertures with particle filters visible; small transparent viewport on sensor pod showing radiation detector crystal; quick-release battery cartridge on ventral surface
distinctive_features: Oversized sensor pod with visible multi-spectrum optical array
Six articulated rotor arms with tension springs for vibration isolation
Sealed joint design—no exposed wiring or gaps where contamination could lodge
Micro-vacuum decontamination intake vent with replaceable filter cartridge
Holographic projection emitter (recessed, top-mounted) for real-time map data display
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS angular logo embossed on dorsal fuselage; TEND-3 model designation on battery cartridge; CBRN CERTIFIED regulatory stamps on sensor shroud; batch serialization and decontamination protocol QR code on undercarriage
physical_description.condition_typical: Post-mission: visible residue on sensor windows requiring UV decontamination cycle; rotor arms may show thermal discoloration from extended operation; filter cartridge replaced regularly; magnetic charging contacts kept meticulously clean
